text: Age: 39
Occupation: Public Utility Analyst

strong: Endorsed by: Duarte Mayor Tera Martin Del Campo, Mayor Pro-Tem Sam Kang, Councilmember Cesar Garcia, and Councilmember Vin Truong

text: As a longtime resident, I believe Duarte needs a fresh breath of air. Every City reaches a point where it must ask an important question: What kind of Leadership do we need for the future? Duarte is changing and we need someone with fresh ideas and energy. The new challenges we are facing require not only experience but also a fresh perspective with leadership that reflects what Duarte is becoming. This Campaign is not about looking backward; it's about looking forward to today and the future.
For Duarte to thrive, we need a NEW LEADER who combines experience with new approaches.

Duarte has a proud history and it's time to build on that foundation. Duarte deserves a LEADER who will embrace creative solutions to the issues we face today. I will collaborate with local and neighboring leadership, listen to our constituents and business owners, and bring ENERGY to be present at ALL MEETINGS. I would like to focus on investing in our Public Safety, attracting Economic Development so we don't have to shop and dine in neighboring cities, supporting local businesses, and strengthening our community programs to enrich the lives of the next generations.

When elected, I will prioritize fiscal responsibility, public safety, park improvements, economic development, and support small businesses. I would like to see Duarte retain its small-town charm while also attracting businesses important to our community. VOTE -
to take a seat as your Councilmember in District 1.
